cohort: 73,977 randomly selected deliveries from 94 hospitals across 23 provinces in China
finding: The caesarean delivery rate in China in 2015-2016 was 38.9%, with significant regional variation, indicating a potential for reduction, particularly by addressing repeat caesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean delivery was the most common indication for caesarean delivery, accounting for 38.2% of all caesarean deliveries.
